claim_one_line: THE SPECTRUM LAW REBUILT FROM THE REPOSITORY'S OWN 27 AND EXTENDED. B1086's named residual (an own-code rebuild of the dial matrices hv8/hv16) is paid on the one exact object the repository holds, B883's rep27.json: B854's bracket re-implemented and rep27 checked to be a representation; the principal sl2 with 27 = 17+9+1; the six dial slots as the highest-weight vectors of the principal blocks; theta-parity by bracket closure (hv8, hv16 -> e6 of dim 78; hv10, hv14, hv22 -> f4 of dim 52 -- B265/B576 recomputed); the subregular E6(a1) with orbit dimension 70 and 27 = 13+9+5. Then, exactly over Q(omega) with every group element a polynomial in a nilpotent: h1(M;27) = 3 = h1(M;27bar) (modular and exact elimination agree); on the twisted double h1(D_t;27) = 5/2/2/2 for hv8 and for hv16 at t = 0/1/2/omega, 5/5/5/5 for the theta-even hv14 -- B1086's law cell for cell -- and, computed for the first time, h1(D_t;27bar) equals h1(D_t;27) in every cell. EXTENSION to B1257's subregular embedding: h1(M;27) = 3 = h1(M;27bar) with h0 = 0 (no trivial block), and the double with the eight centralizer dials gives 6 untwisted and 4 or 6 for the dense dials, never 3 and always 27 = 27bar. Consequence for JOIN 1: the twisted rows rest on two independent instruments; the closed wall is seen numerically in every cell; and B1257's route, even if I-25 were earned, yields three VECTOR-LIKE classes on the cusped object and 4 or 6 on the double, never a net count.
